title: Today’s trade finance challenges (part 2)
summary: Shifting customer expectations in banking paired with new technological breakthroughs and methodologies are affecting the delivery of bank services. API usage has greatly enhanced the ability for bank applications and platforms to communicate with one another in an understood language. Interaction with these new business networks is nearly impossible without leveraging the latest communication protocols. Interoperability is critical to success, particularly as the number of mobile services and external networks that banks must connect to has expanded.
